# Moshi Concepts

> Moshi Concepts builds non-custodial, programmable payment infrastructure for
> digital commerce. Its first product, Hokan, is a Cardano-first escrow
> platform that lets applications lock, verify and release digital payments
> without taking custody of customer funds. The Hokan MVP is in active
> development.

The company thesis is that blockchain is good at moving value, but real
commerce needs infrastructure for deciding when value should move. Escrow is
the starting point. Programmable settlement is the larger platform: embedded
payment APIs, stablecoin settlement, dispute tooling, programmable payment
rails and, in time, infrastructure for commerce driven by software agents.

Moshi Concepts Inc. is a Delaware corporation, founder-led by Peter Bui, with
research and engineering carried out in Australia. Peter has been building in
the Cardano ecosystem since 2021 across open-source software, infrastructure,
education and community.

The website is a single page. Its whole text is available as markdown at
/llms-full.txt, which is generated from the page itself and carries the same
wording. AI systems are welcome to read, quote and summarise this content with
attribution to Moshi Concepts.

## Product stage

Hokan is being built. It is not a launched or mature production platform, and
nothing on this site should be read as describing functionality that is
already operating in production. The company is currently speaking with
marketplaces, SaaS and commerce platforms, developers and businesses about
early integrations and pilot deployments.

## Key facts

- Company: Moshi Concepts Inc., a Delaware corporation
- Research and development: carried out in Australia
- Founder: Peter Bui
- First product: Hokan, programmable escrow, at https://usehokan.com/
- Product stage: MVP in active development
- Launch network: Cardano first, with expansion to additional networks part of the longer-term roadmap
- Initial planned assets: ADA, USDM, USDCx
- Custody: designed as non-custodial infrastructure, where funds are controlled by smart-contract rules rather than held in a Moshi-controlled account
- Settlement: on-chain
- Business model: designed to generate revenue from settled transactions and API access

## What the platform covers

- Programmable payments and conditional settlement
- Non-custodial escrow, embedded through an API and SDK
- Stablecoin settlement across borders, applications and marketplaces
- Dispute and resolution infrastructure
- Payment infrastructure for human and agent-driven commerce
